stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.settings.s: Window behavior during gameplay and startup
stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.tooltip.mi: This is Minecraft's regular Exclusive Fullscreen setting.
stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.tooltip.pr: Only affects native fullscreen; borderless normally stays visible when unfocused.
stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.tooltip.fu: Fills the current monitor with an undecorated desktop-sized window.
stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.tooltip.lo: Uses the game's saved fullscreen setting while loading.
Keeps the loading screen windowed, regardless of the game setting.
Shows the loading screen fullscreen, regardless of the game setting.
stop_minimizing_on_focus_loss.tooltip.st: Keep the window minimized until loading ends.
